{{Quote|Do you see this?"<br>"Yes."<br>"I am going to take this blaster and shoot everyone in this office in front of your eyes if you don't give me the information.|Malorum and the manager|<ref name="Death on Naboo" />}}
The [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Malorum]] owned a [[Blaster/Legends|'''blaster''']]. He used this blaster to threaten the manager of [[Naboo Essentials Provider]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Malorum threatened to kill everyone inside the building in front of the managers eyes if the manager did not give up the address of [[Ryoo Thule]]. The manager, realizing Malorum was completely capable of it, gave up the address. Malorum stormed out of the building, wanting to have blasted the manager.<ref name="Death on Naboo" />

Malorum later used the blaster against [[Ferus Olin]] during his escape from the [[Translucence Cove]] at [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] shortly after Malorum killed Ryoo Thule, once he learned of Amidala's children still being alive from Thule.<ref name="Death on Naboo" />
